name: JfrogCliV2
description: Run your own JFrog CLI command.
author: JFrog

inputs.name: jfrogPlatformConnection
inputs.label: JFrog Platform service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: JFrog Platform service connection to use in the command.

inputs.name: useCustomVersion
inputs.label: Use custom JFrog CLI version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select to use a specific JFrog CLI version.

inputs.name: cliVersion
inputs.label: Version
inputs.helpMarkDown:
Specify the version of JFrog CLI to use.
You can also set $(jfrogCliVersion).

inputs.name: command
inputs.label: Commands to run
inputs.helpMarkDown: Set your JFrog CLI command after 'jf '. There is no need to provide the URL, the credentials or the server ID options. Multiple commands are supported also by providing lines with linebreaks. Default build name and number will be automatically appended using environment variables.

inputs.name: workingDirectory
inputs.label: Working Directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: The working directory where the command will run. When empty, the value of '$(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)' is used.

inputs.name: enablePackageAlias
inputs.label: Enable Package Alias (Ghost Frog)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Install JFrog CLI's package-alias shims (requires JFrog CLI 2.93.0 or later), which transparently route native build tool commands (npm, mvn, gradle, dotnet, nuget, pip, go, docker, etc.) through 'jf' for the rest of the pipeline job.

inputs.name: packageAliasTools
inputs.label: Package Alias Tools
inputs.helpMarkDown: Comma-separated list of tools to enable package aliasing for (e.g. 'npm,dotnet'). Leave empty to enable all supported tools.
